ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 7
   C. 5
   D. 1

2. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 21
   C. 90
   D. 42

3. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.6
   B. 25
   C. 19
   D. 19.7

4. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 26
   C. 25
   D. 5

5. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 82
   C. 81
   D. 18

6. Solve for x: x + 3 = 10. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 10
   C. 3
   D. 8

7. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 49
   C. 14
   D. 7

8. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 25
   C. 11
   D. 5

9. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 34
   B. 17
   C. 66
   D. 22

10. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31
   C. 31.7
   D. 31.6

11. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 12x
   D. 6x

12. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 400

13. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 122
   C. 121
   D. 22

14. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 43
   D. 1

15. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 13
   C. 40
   D. 41

16. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 56
   B. 1
   C. 15
   D. 57

17. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 400

18. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15.6
   C. 15
   D. 15.7

19. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 18
   C. 90
   D. 81

20. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. They are equal
   C. 1/4
   D. 2/2

21. What is √81? (1 mark)
   A. 40.5
   B. 81
   C. 10
   D. 9

22. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

23. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.6
   B. 29
   C. 23.7
   D. 23

24. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x < 5
   B. x = 5
   C. x ≥ 0 only
   D. x > 5

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
